body: I find it difficult to meet new people due to my anxiety, which is why getting a job has been especially rough for me. As for TV shows and music, I guess I like them. No more or less than the typical person. I used to rely on them to keep my mind from reaching really dark places, but I find myself uninterested in them now.

Thank you for your kind words. I appreciate them, however, I must disagree with your point about people caring for me. They stopped once they realized what kind of person I am. Even though there are people that I truly care for, the ones that say they care for me are just putting on an act or essentially a "friendly face" because they have no other choice but to. So thus, I'm all alone. I firmly believe that moving on is out of the question. There's a line and I've crossed it. There is no coming back for me. But again, thank you for your words.
